name: feature-rows
title: Stacked feature story rows
description: Two narrative feature rows with contextual detail cards and destination links.

files.content:
HOW THE WORK FLOWS

One story, two complementary capabilities

01 / Plan with context

Bring the brief, relevant decisions and open questions together before work begins.

Explore planning features
Planning checklist
  • Define the outcome
  • Capture requirements
  • Assign next steps

02 / Report what changed

Present progress as a readable narrative, with evidence and next actions close at hand.

Explore reporting features
Update summary
  • Progress: example review
  • Next step: share findings

Illustrative workflow and sample labels; connect real data where appropriate.
